objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has modified windows firewall rules to allow for discovery actions using `netsh advfirewall firewall set rule group=”Network Discovery” new enable=Yes` and using the PowerShell command `-Command Get-NetFirewall Rule -DisplayGroup “Network Discovery” | Enable-NetFirewallRule`.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026) [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has also modified firewall rules to allow remote desktop access using the command `netsh firewall set service type remotedesktop mode enable` or `netsh advfirewall firewall set rule group="remote desktop" new enable=Yes`.(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026) [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has also deactivated Windows firewall rules using the command ` netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off`. [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has disabled the Windows Firewall settings using the PowerShell cmdlet `powershell -Command Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain,Public,Private -Enabled False`.(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
